method: Every rendered page was viewed as an image by the manuscript agent. Pages changed by later edits (2, 3, 11-14) were re-viewed after the rebuilds that changed them; page 13 (Table 2) was re-viewed after the final edit. Page breaks of the final build were checked with pdftotext. This is a typesetting inspection, not a mathematical review.
